notes.title: Announcing FWsim v4
notes.notes:
With FWsim v4, planning your shows is now much faster & easier!

[previewyoutube=D-tLSNYA1NI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Show Editor Improvements[/h1]
➜ Better display of positions, with 3D cylinders - so you can better see where the positions actually are in 3D space
➜ Put steppers through multiple positions (this allows you, for example, to run a stepper in a circle)
➜ New “Fly Around” camera controls - more efficient & intuitive
➜ Comfortable angle selection in 3D window
➜ Select position first, then add cues
➜ Select multiple positions to add multiple cues
➜ In position setup mode, you can select multiple positions and move them together
➜ Stepper renamed “Sequence”
➜ Toolbox made smaller, so you have more space for your timeline
➜ Now using the CTRL key to select multiple items in the timeline, instead of SHIFT (to match the Windows standard)
➜ When pasting, cues are pasted onto the position that is selected in the 3D window
➜ You can copy shots from a single position, and paste them onto multiple other positions

[h1]Effects Improvements[/h1]
➜ More effects available
➜ Some old effects, which were of lower quality, are now hidden
➜ Adjust gravity for stars
➜ New types of blinking
➜ More colors available
➜ Can now attach ascent effect components to rockets


Let us know how it goes! We look forwards to seeing what you make with it.

notes.title: Create better 3D worlds with the Water Removal Tool
notes.notes:
Hi FWsim fans!

In 2023, we added a feature to load Google Earth 3D scenery into FWsim (avabile under Show -> Scenery -> "Real Location").

We also added a water system, allowing you to add water to the scenery (available under Show -> Scenery).

Usually, this works really well: set the water height correctly, and it blends in nicely with the Google Earth data

However, in some locations there is a "spillover" effect, where water enters areas that should be dry:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/a446711136d7852dd9950b12968b76ad09060fae.png[/img]

Here's how to solve this:

1. Open the Water Removal Tool from the menu bar
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/a678c3aa8e68f86401871525ff3810d739d88bfd.png[/img]


2. With your mouse, you can now erase the water. (Use the mouse wheel to make the brush bigger or smaller)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/286cdf63d254f1576f0a77e92f1153899968454c.png[/img]

3. Close the window, and the changes will be saved. Your environment will now look correct.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/68487ad4a492b34b1dd2c9ddf5e54bd4b24471c1.png[/img]

notes.title: The Entire World in 3D - FWsim 3.5 Beta 1
notes.notes:
Dear FWsim Community,

we are excited to announce this beta update with the following features:

[h1]Loading the entire World in 3D[/h1]

FWsim could load 3D models in the past. But if you wanted to simulate a real place, you might face challenges. You’d either have to make your own 3D models or try to find the desired building models online. Yet, typically, you’d only find isolated buildings, not the entire landscape.

The latest version, FWsim 3.5, solves this problem. Now, you can [b]launch fireworks anywhere in the world, in 3D[/b]. It not only provides the location you want, but also includes the entire surrounding area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/40277890967cb4668f909d3e108da7ed2ee4f9a0.jpg[/img]

Our data is provided by Google and consists of 3D terrain (hills and mountains) for the entire surface of the earth. It also includes 3D buildings for thousands of cities. The data is downloaded on request. Please note, since we rely on an external data provider, there is a risk this feature might stop working in the future.

Here’s how to use it:

[olist]
[*] Find the geographical coordinates (latitude and longitude) in decimal degrees, for example 51,503° / 0.00° for a location in London. To get coordinates, simply open Google Maps and right-click on the point you want:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/3bac3773cef494ddd2017e9abd621d9ccfbecb4f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/80787e7c72af223c3e1478a5745ec4d8e29448e2.png[/img][/url]
[*] Open an existing show in FWsim or create a new one.
[*] Click Show → Scenery, and select the “Real Location” option.
[*] Enter your coordinates and click “Load”. Please make sure to use the right decimal separators. For example, if your Windows is set to German number format, you need to enter “51,50178” whereas on an English computer you would type “51.50178”.
[*] Depending on the location you load, your camera might be below the terrain. If you don’t see anything, move your camera upwards.
[/olist]

If you would like to preview interesting locations, or find out how good the data is at certain places, please use [url=https://www.google.com/earth/versions/]Google Earth[/url].

[h1]Better placement of Fireworks on Buildings[/h1]
In previous versions of FWsim, it was difficult to place fireworks on buildings. In this version, this is much easier and more intuitive.

[h1]How to activate the Beta[/h1]
Please right-click FWsim in your Steam Library, and select “Properties”. There you can choose to participate in the beta:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/f3f2640650c79244c825d119274b274831008b97.png[/img]


[h1]Show us your work![/h1]
We look forwards to seeing what you do with the new features. You can post your shows here in the discussions, or at the [url=https://community.fwsim.com/]FWsim community forum[/url].

notes.title: FWsim 3.4.1 - Lancework, Better Performance
notes.notes:
FWsim 3.4.1 is now available! Here's what's new:

[b]Lancework[/b]
FWsim 3.4.1 comes with a new Lancework effect type. Lanceworks are pieces made from wood, with glowing dots arranged in shapes or letters. You can create Lancework through the Effects Editor, and draw your own shape:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347348/6ec8738bcff36b49cd8f902b056dcbb595f3b34c.png[/img]

[b]Improved Performance, Reduced Memory Usage[/b]
We switched to a newer version of the Microsoft .NET Framework, which should give better performance. We also managed to reduce memory usage.

In our quest for better performance, we also changed the way the light falls onto the environment. It should now run faster.

notes.title: FWsim 3.3 Now Available
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for your feature ideas! The latest update, FWsim 3.3, is now ready. 

[list]
[*] New firework selection window with better filters and animated preview. Helping you to understand the different types of firework effects, even if you have never used FWsim before.
[*] Effect Editor: Pause, scroll forwards and backwards in time, and see your updates instantly. That way, you can pause on an important moment in the effect, make your changes, and easily understand the changes you make.
[*] Even more performance improvements
[*] Right-click in effect selection window to delete effects you no longer need
[*] Some very old effects were removed from the library, and replaced with new designs. (The old effects are still included as a ZIP file in the FWsim program directory, located in your Steam folder - in case you want to get them back for any reason)

[*] Effect Editor: Special tail components now available. These tail components can be inserted instead of a normal tail, and they represent real types of tails. This is a good way to immediately make your effects more realistic! There are also some components available for realistic ascent effects on shells.
[*] Effect Editor: Stars can be configured to not change color when using the "change color" option in the show editor.
[*] Effect Editor: Ascent Stars can be configured to change color when using the "change color" option in the show editor. (this is off by default)
[*] New option to automatically go back to starting point after playing in the show editor.
[*] Users without a middle mouse button can now use the CTRL key plus left mouse button to move the free camera.
[*] Improved layout on 4K monitors
[/list]

What's your wishlist for the next updates? Let us know - we look forwards to hearing from you!

notes.title: FWsim 3.3. is coming!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It’s a pleasure to see on social media how much you’re enjoying [b]FWsim[/b] these days. While enjoying some of your breathtaking shows, we’ve been working hard on making FWsim better and easier to use. These upgrades will be included with the [b]FWsim 3.3 update[/b], which is expected to see the light [b]by the end of May[/b]. Here’s a comprehensive list of changes to come:

[list]
[*] Improved realism of included effects: We will replace some of the old effects in the database with redesigned versions, to take advantage of all the latest improvements in our fireworks rendering.

[*] Improved performance. FWsim already runs well even on old computers, and with this update we’ll make it even faster to load and run.

[*] Improved effect selection window: Thanks to new icons, new users who are unfamiliar with real fireworks can get a quick sense of the different types available. Animated previews will help you understand how the effect will look like once it’s integrated into the show. And the window will load slightly faster, therefore making your show design process more fun.

[*] Improved camera moves: We plan to add a new camera animation timeline. This will make it easier to animate camera moves. It will also allow new types of camera moves that have not been possible previously.

[*] Improved camera positioning: In FWsim 3.3, you will be able to select from a range of predefined viewpoints, or create your own. That will make it easier to view your show from different angles, and see how your design really looks like.

[*] Improved effect editor with more beautiful tails. As you perhaps know, “tails” are trails of sparks that are pulled behind the stars of a firework. These tails will be highly realistic and have been carefully designed by our pyrotechnics expert. This is a great way to instantly make your effects better: Simply add one of the presets to your effect, and you’ll get amazingly realistic tails.
[/list]

[url=https://ibb.co/QX2XYMG][img]https://i.ibb.co/0QgQYr3/2021-04-15-17-23-29-Select-a-firework-effect.png[/img][/url]

This image shows the new effect selection window, with easier color selection, nicer filters, and animated previews of each piece of firework.

Now you know what’s coming to FWsim in the near future. Stay tuned to the Announcements section so you don’t miss anything about our next updates. Also, we invite you to follow us on  Twitter and Facebook to join the conversation -- we’ll be happy to answer any questions you may have about FWsim, and always eager to share your amazing firework displays! We’ll be here again soon to tell you more about the next FWsim Challenge. Until then, have a nice week and stay safe!

notes.title: FWsim is available now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, and [b]welcome to FWsim: Fireworks Display Simulator![/b]

This is a very exciting day for me: FWsim is finally available on Steam Early Access. I released the first version in 2010, and always had one goal in mind: to create the most realistic fireworks simulator available. Something that is [b]close to reality and useful for fireworks professionals, [/b]but also intuitive, [b]easy and fun for amateurs[/b] and fireworks enthusiasts. It’s been over a decade now, and thousands of simulations - and real fireworks shows planned with FWsim - are a testament that this goal has been achieved.

Fireworks Design is both a science and an art. Unlike other forms of art, pyrotechnics is available only to a handful of professionals. Not anymore! [b]FWsim makes it possible for anyone to create their own fireworks show and express themselves[/b] in this unique medium. My intention with the Early Access Launch is to bring this experience to more people. People like you, who might love fireworks but haven't had any direct experience with them yet.

This is just the beginning of the road, of course – as you can see in the Early Access FAQ. [b]FWsim is already a complete fireworks simulation experience.[/b] You won’t find an incomplete or half-done product here: from the get-go, you will have lots of fun designing your fireworks shows, and you’ll be able to [b]share it with your friends on social media, Youtube, etc. [/b]We’re working to make it easier to use over the next months, and there are many ideas on the table: better graphics, better UI, new game mechanics…

[b]Your feedback will be essential.[/b] The ideas of you and other players like you will help shape the next version of FWsim and guide the whole development process. You can join the community here in the Steam forums and follow our social media channels ([url=https://twitter.com/FWsimFireworks]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/FWsimFireworksSimulator/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/fwsim_fireworks/]Instagram[/url]). We also have an [url=https://community.fwsim.com]active community forum[/url] where very experienced FWsim users hang out. Thanks a lot for being here and for your support; I’m looking forward to meeting you in the community and [b]seeing your first fireworks displays![/b]
